P01.rationale: A photo of two people is present in the left column but it is relatively small (roughly a quarter of the page height) and functions as a client portrait rather than a dominant founder anchor filling a major portion of the page.

P05.rationale: A clearly framed client photo labelled 'Frese Recruiting' appears at meaningful size in the left column, though it is somewhat smaller than the roughly one-third column benchmark seen in the references.

P07.rationale: A testimonial quote block with attribution is present in the lower-left panel, providing minimal social proof, but there is no logo wall, rating cards, or review grid.

P10.rationale: A faint ghost numeral '3' appears in the top-right corner of the page, but it is small and subtle rather than a boldly oversized decorative typographic element; a large opening quote glyph appears in the testimonial box.

P11.rationale: Three clearly labelled before/after metric cards (reaction time, WhatsApp chats, headcount) are displayed in a dark banner, providing real data bound to numbers, though no charts or cost-math visuals are used.

P12.rationale: The upper two-thirds of the page is reasonably filled, but the lower portion of the right column and the bottom of the page are largely empty, preventing a dense magazine-quality feel.

P13.rationale: The background is flat white with no texture, atmospheric treatment, or tonal variation anywhere on the page.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable; scored 0 as absent.

P16.rationale: A QR code is shown in the left column but no phone, laptop, or book mockup is present to add product credibility.

N07.rationale: The client photo appears to be a real, specific business photo (two people with a branded award/logo visible), reducing the generic stock feel, though the overall imagery is limited.

N08.rationale: A large empty white region occupies the bottom quarter of the page below the testimonial and results sections, representing significant purposeless dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over a busy photo without a scrim; the photo and text areas are cleanly separated into distinct zones.
